versos.e: Brings indifference to worldly good 1Co 7:29-31; Col 3:1-3
Defined as love and devotion to God De 6:5; Jos 22:5; 1Ki 8:23; Ps 1:2; 51:6
Is produced by the indwelling of the Holy Spirit Joh 14:16,17; Ro 8:4
Described as the great and enduring good Lu 10:42
Engenders thirst for heavenly blessings Mt 5:6; Joh 6:27
